no_privacy_notice.title: Privacy notice not published
no_privacy_notice.action: Publish the privacy notice shown to residents under Settings > KVKK (KVKK art.10).

low_consent.title: Explicit consent coverage is low ({pct}%)
low_consent.action: WhatsApp/SMS delivery requires explicit consent. Send a one-off consent request to residents without it (KVKK art.5).

overdue_requests.title: {count} data subject request(s) are past their deadline
overdue_requests.action: Close overdue requests immediately; delay can lead to a complaint to the Authority (KVKK art.13).

blocked_announcements.title: {count} announcement(s) were blocked for a KVKK breach
blocked_announcements.action: Never name debtors or their units in announcements; publish aggregate figures anonymously instead.

stale_residents.title: {count} former resident record(s) are still not anonymised
stale_residents.action: Anonymise personal data of former residents once the retention period ends (KVKK art.7).

no_verbis.title: No VERBİS registration on file
no_verbis.action: VERBİS registration is mandatory above the headcount and balance-sheet thresholds; verify your registration.

no_dpo.title: No contact person assigned
no_dpo.action: Define the data controller contact person and address under Settings.

breaches.title: {count} data breach notification(s) in the last 12 months
breaches.action: Review your incident response plan; breaches must be reported to the Authority within 72 hours.

no_mfa.title: Two-factor authentication is off for the manager account
no_mfa.action: Enable two-factor authentication for manager accounts (KVKK art.12 technical measure).

identity_docs.title: {count} copies of identity documents are stored
identity_docs.action: Do not store ID copies unless strictly required; delete the unnecessary ones (data minimisation).

retention.financialRecords: Statutory bookkeeping retention (Tax Procedure Law art.253 — 5 years)
retention.decisionBook: Decision book records are kept indefinitely (KMK art.32)
retention.auditLog: Access and activity logs are kept as a security obligation (Law no. 5651)

anonymize.anonymizeName: The name is replaced with "Former resident"
anonymize.anonymizeContact: Email and phone are irreversibly masked
anonymize.anonymizeVote: The vote is kept, the link to the voter is severed
anonymize.anonymizeRequest: The request is kept, the link to the requester is severed

unit_debt_disclosure.message: The debt status of a specific unit cannot be disclosed to the community.
unit_debt_disclosure.suggestion: Announce the aggregate amount anonymously instead of the unit number, and notify the debtor individually.

name_debt_disclosure.message: A person's name cannot be published together with debt information (KVKK art.5).
name_debt_disclosure.suggestion: Remove the name; send the payment reminder only to the person concerned.

tckn.message: A national ID number must be protected like special category data and cannot appear in an announcement.
tckn.suggestion: Remove the ID number from the text.

iban.message: Sharing an IBAN carries a fraud risk and constitutes personal data.
iban.suggestion: Deliver payment details through the portal or an individual notification.

phone.message: A phone number is personal data and should not be shared in a bulk announcement.
phone.suggestion: Remove the number, or list only the management contact number.

plate.message: A vehicle plate makes the individual identifiable.
plate.suggestion: Partially mask the plate or notify the vehicle owner individually.

health.message: Health information is special category personal data and cannot be shared without explicit consent (KVKK art.6).
health.suggestion: Remove any statements about health conditions.

religion_politics.message: Religion, belief and political opinion are special category data.
religion_politics.suggestion: Rewrite the statement in neutral terms.

legal_threat.message: Announcements containing threats or demeaning language create legal risk.
legal_threat.suggestion: Describe the legal process objectively, citing the relevant statute.
